tasks.subject: Task 1: Endpoint routing engine (agent/configs)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replicate the CLI's ProviderEndpointRoutingService: lazy 5-min-TTL refresh of agent/configs, strict mapping validation, per-request URL resolution with fail-open, and repin the relay vendor to the CLI's baked-in pre-routing URL.

**Files:**
- Create: ModelProxy/Services/EndpointMapping.swift (pure logic), ModelProxy/Services/EndpointConfigService.swift (actor)
- Modify: ModelProxy/Proxy/RelayTarget.swift:358-431 (sendOnce resolves URL; relayHeaders gains X-ZCode-Authorization), ModelProxy/Proxy/ProxyServer.swift:148-197, ModelProxy/Models/AppConfig.swift:214 + ConfigStore (one-time migration to https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/zcode-plan/anthropic)
- Test: ModelProxyTests/EndpointMappingTests.swift, ModelProxyTests/EndpointConfigServiceTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- parse rejects non-https/userinfo/query/fragment URLs, >256 entries, duplicate from, bad zcodeAuthorizationHeader values/targets; whole-mapping rejection
- flagged rewrite returns new URL (query preserved) + addZcodeAuthorization=true; trailing-slash-insensitive lookup
- lazy refresh: 300 s TTL, 30 s failure cooldown, 3 s timeout, single-flight; failure serves last snapshot; no snapshot fails open to original URL
- relay path consults per request; x-zcode-authorization: Bearer zcodejwttoken added when flagged (omitted when token absent)
- idempotent migration of the exact ultra-zai pin to pre-routing; user-edited vendors untouched

**Verify:** xcodebuild test -project ZGate.xcodeproj -scheme ZGate -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/EndpointMappingTests -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/EndpointConfigServiceTests

```json:metadata
{"files": ["ModelProxy/Services/EndpointMapping.swift", "ModelProxy/Services/EndpointConfigService.swift", "ModelProxy/Proxy/RelayTarget.swift", "ModelProxy/Proxy/ProxyServer.swift", "ModelProxy/Models/AppConfig.swift"], "verifyCommand": "xcodebuild test -project ZGate.xcodeproj -scheme ZGate -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/EndpointMappingTests -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/EndpointConfigServiceTests", "acceptanceCriteria": ["hostile mapping rejected wholesale", "fail-open on fetch failure/timeout", "pre-routing migration idempotent"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Per-conversation session identity
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Modify: ModelProxy/Proxy/RelayTarget.swift (Context.sessionID :100-101 becomes fallback; new SessionIdentity.derive(from:fallback:))
- Test: ModelProxyTests/RelayTargetTests.swift:661-685

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- same CC session header → identical x-session-id across requests; different conversations differ
- agent-id present → type subagent + id "<session>-<8-hex SHA-256 of agent id>"; absent → main
- garbage inbound ids (<8, >64, non-hex-ish) fall back to per-process UUID
- PoW + Ed25519 sig use the derived id
- no CC headers → identical to today

tasks.subject: Task 6: Business-code error taxonomy
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Parse upstream business codes from drained error bodies (JSON-parsed envelope code only — never substring, logids collide) and route remediation by class.

**Files:**
- Create: ModelProxy/Proxy/RelayErrorTaxonomy.swift
- Modify: ModelProxy/Proxy/RelayTarget.swift:205-314 (handleReject/handleRateLimited), :470-495 (drainErrorBody → RelayUpstreamError), sendOnce 200-envelope check
- Test: ModelProxyTests/RelayErrorTaxonomyTests.swift, ladder tests :846-1133

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- classification: 1005/1113/1310+402 → quotaExhausted; 1302/1303 → rateLimited; 3008/3009/3010 → concurrencyLimited; 3012 or 405 → riskControl; 3007 → captchaChallenge; 3006 → modelNotAllowed; 1210/3001 → invalidParameter; 1114 never classified
- remediation: exhausted no-retry+quota tick+fallback; rateLimited existing single backoff; concurrency 2 retries 3s/6s+jitter; riskControl no-retry+900s cooldown (RelayHealth); captcha surfaced; 400-class surfaced
- 401 VERIFY ladder + expired-relogin detection unchanged
- 200-with-business-envelope (code!=0, no type:message) classified, not relayed as success
- logid collision test: code 1302 with "1113…3009" inside a 20-digit logid → rateLimited

**Verify:** xcodebuild test … -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/RelayErrorTaxonomyTests -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/RelayTargetTests

tasks.subject: Task 7: API-key fallback + RelayHealth
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Mint the signing-free api.z.ai/api/anthropic credential via the /copy chain, add it as fallback vendor, degrade to it with half-open recovery probes (60s→300s cap) — signing outages become degraded-service, not terminal 502.

**Files:**
- Create: ModelProxy/Signing/ApiKeyMinter.swift, ModelProxy/Proxy/RelayHealth.swift
- Modify: ModelProxy/Signing/SigningClient.swift (expose biz JWT + api/biz helper; mintProjectToken :414-447 as template), ModelProxy/Proxy/ProxyForwarder.swift:859-922 (degraded routing), ModelProxy/Models/AppConfig.swift + ConfigStore (fallback vendor seed/migration, applyGLMCanonicalization flag), ModelProxy/Proxy/ProxyServer.swift:369-389
- Test: ModelProxyTests/ApiKeyMinterTests.swift, ModelProxyTests/RelayHealthTests.swift, ProxyForwarderTests

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- mint chain (15 s/call): biz JWT → getCustomerInfo → org 默认机构/else-first, project 默认项目/else-first → list api_keys → find zcode-api-key else create → copy/{apiKey} → secretKey → "apiKey.secretKey" persisted as vendor apiKey
- fallback vendor .anthropic, https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic, stripsClaudeOnlyRequestFields true, applyGLMCanonicalization true; seeded+migrated as catch-all backup, idempotent, user edits untouched
- RelayHealth: degradedSigning on signingUnavailable/transportFailed-after-retries; probe only when now>=nextProbeAt (60s base ×2 cap 300s); success → healthy; credentialsExpired serves fallback without probing; riskCooldown(900s) blocks relay, not fallback
- fallback 401 re-mints once; fallback 1113 cools key 1h; fallback outcomes never touch relay health
- no fallback vendor configured → today's behavior

**Verify:** xcodebuild test … -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/ApiKeyMinterTests -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/RelayHealthTests; full suite green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["ModelProxy/Signing/ApiKeyMinter.swift", "ModelProxy/Proxy/RelayHealth.swift", "ModelProxy/Signing/SigningClient.swift", "ModelProxy/Proxy/ProxyForwarder.swift", "ModelProxy/Models/AppConfig.swift"], "verifyCommand": "xcodebuild test -project ZGate.xcodeproj -scheme ZGate -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/RelayHealthTests", "acceptanceCriteria": ["mint chain works", "half-open probe cadence", "fallback never launders relay state"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: Off-peak ticket control plane
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement the official-client ticket-queue control plane (availability/take/status/settle) as a standalone, stub-testable client for the Off-Peak / Idle Plan — an unsigned coding-plan perk.

**Files:**
- Create: ModelProxy/Services/OffPeakTicketClient.swift
- Test: ModelProxyTests/OffPeakTicketClientTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- GET {origin}/api/v1/off-peak/ticket/availability → (canTake, nextTakeAt unix s; next_take_at mandatory when false)
- POST /api/v1/off-peak/ticket {task_id} → OffPeakTicket {ticketID, state queued|ready|active|settled|expired|not_found, position?, activeDeadlineMs?, nextPollAfterSeconds?}
- POST /api/v1/off-peak/ticket/status {ticket_ids} (chunk ≤100) → (tickets, nextPollAfterSeconds?); active_deadline = deadline to START using a ready ticket
- POST /api/v1/off-peak/ticket/{id}/settle — any 4xx = success; 8 s timeout; never throws
- all calls: {code:0,data} envelope, numeric code==0 success only; 15 s timeout; auth = Authorization Bearer zcode plan JWT + X-Coding-Plan-Api-Key {apiKey}.{secretKey} + Task 2 identity set; NEVER V4-signed
- envelope code != 0 throws typed error with code+msg (no substring parsing)

**Verify:** xcodebuild test … -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/OffPeakTicketClientTests


tasks.subject: Task 10: Async relay surface (/async/v1/messages)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Expose an opt-in, default-OFF local async surface: pre-flight → availability wait → ticket take → poll with SSE keepalives → unsigned data-plane call with X-Off-Peak-Ticket-ID → untouched SSE relay → settle. State machine WAIT→READY→DONE/EXPIRED/ABORT.

**Files:**
- Create: ModelProxy/Proxy/OffPeakTarget.swift
- Modify: ModelProxy/Proxy/ProxyServer.swift:236-254 (route "/async/" prefix when enabled, before normal forward), ModelProxy/Models/AppConfig.swift (+ ConfigStore migration: offPeak section)
- Test: ModelProxyTests/OffPeakTargetTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- OffPeakConfig {enabled=false, origin=https://zcode.z.ai, maxWaitMinutes=60, pollIntervalSeconds=5, keepaliveSeconds=3}; migration adds section idempotently
- routes: POST /async/v1/messages + GET /async/v1/health; disabled/unknown → Anthropic-shaped 404-style error; usage ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:9090/async
- pre-flight BEFORE any ticket (never leak): enabled, body ≤4 MiB, JSON, stream==true (else async_stream_required), model canonicalized (Task 5 helpers)
- availability false → wait to next_take_at (≤ maxWaitMinutes) with keepalives, re-check; take task_id "zgate-"+uuid
- poll: pollIntervalSeconds or server next_poll_after (server wins when larger); 3 consecutive failures tolerated (backoff min(pollInterval,2s)); ": keepalive\n\n" every keepaliveSeconds while queued, stopping when the data stream starts
- data plane: POST {origin}/api/v1/off-peak/anthropic/v1/messages, Task 2 identity set + Bearer zcode JWT + X-Coding-Plan-Api-Key + X-Off-Peak-Ticket-ID; UNSIGNED; SSE relayed untouched via ResponseRelay
- settle fired on completion/error/disconnect (fire-and-forget); expired/not_found mid-wait → one re-take within maxWaitMinutes else 529-shaped error
- upstream read timeout = maxWaitMinutes + 30 min (not the 300 s relay default)

**Verify:** xcodebuild test … -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/OffPeakTargetTests; full suite green


tasks.subject: Task 11: Live probes + e2e + docs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Verify fidelity changes against the real plane (probes A–D), extend e2e, land the docs wave.

**Files:**
- Modify: scripts/e2e/scenarios.sh, docs/00-AI-CONTEXT.md, docs/signing-notes.md, CHANGELOG.md; Create docs/05-features/2026-11-20-relay-fidelity-resilience.md; docs/03-decisions/ amendments

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Probe A: pre-routing pin resolves via agent/configs to ultra target, request succeeds; if pre-routing fails while mapping unavailable, revert migration target and record finding
- Probe B: Authorization-only (no x-api-key) on relay plane; green → flip default CLI-faithful + update fixture/tests; rejected → keep both + record
- Probe C: fallback edge round-trip on api.z.ai/api/anthropic/v1/messages with minted key (user confirms quota monitor)
- Probe D: off-peak round-trip (availability → take → one max_tokens:8 request → settle) during the off-peak window; user confirms weekly-quota monitor unmoved; JWT-rejected or quota-billed → keep surface default-OFF + document
- e2e rig green incl. new scenarios (mapping fail-open, degraded fallback, async happy path)
- docs: five transforms + off-peak surface documented; ADR amendments (endpoint discovery, failure philosophy, session identity, async plane) with evidence; CHANGELOG drafted

**Verify:** scripts/e2e/build.sh && up.sh && scenarios.sh && down.sh → pass; full xcodebuild test suite green
